scripts.check: npm run lint:check && npm run format:check
scripts.test:integration: npm run migrations:test && cross-env NODE_ENV=testing jest __tests__/integration/ --runInBand
scripts.migrations:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only node_modules/knex/bin/cli.js migrate:latest --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrations:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=testing node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only node_modules/knex/bin/cli.js migrate:latest --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrations:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only node_modules/knex/bin/cli.js migrate:latest --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migration:add: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only node_modules/knex/bin/cli.js migrate:make --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.seed:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only node_modules/knex/bin/cli.js seed:run --knexfile knexfile.ts
